keyTakeawayCard.gentle: Chapter 13 says stronger focus and better answers need a larger direction to serve. Keller introduces purpose as the broader aim that gives focus meaning, while warning that purpose only counts when it starts guiding real choices instead of remaining vague inspiration.
keyTakeawayCard.direct: The chapter gives focus a governing reason without letting purpose stay decorative.
keyTakeawayCard.competitive: Give the sharp work a bigger aim, or it stays efficient and small.
